name: callback-reaching-a-parameter
description: A function of the target passed for a parameter, an arrow function or a function a name refers to, by a call that names the function declaring the parameter, stands for the signature a call through that parameter resolves to, so an object literal passed there is read only as that function reads it. A call that reaches the function through another name is not followed, so its callee keeps no implementation and the literal reads every member.
